Question 15
?

The number of sales S of a particular book increases with time. The rate of change of the number of sales is proportional to the square of the number of sales. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of sales of the book at time t?

a
dSdt=kS,k>0
b
dSdt=−kS,k>0
c
dSdt=−kS2,k>0
d
dSdt=kS2,k>0
e
dSdt=kS2,k>0
